name: not-applicable-is-per-pathogen
why: Question 4.10 — whether equipment required for the test is available — is Not Applicable for one pathogen and answered for the other. Section 4 repeats per pathogen, so Not Applicable attaches to the instance and not to the question code: HIV is scored out of 44 while syphilis is scored out of 46. Collapsing the two would either drop a scored question or count an inapplicable one.
